items.requirement: Clean checkout migrates, atomically seeds, builds, and starts API, worker, dispatcher, and production UI using only published commands.
OpenAPI, strict validation, deterministic scoring, thresholds, frozen RuleVersion, RuleHits, and tenant isolation match the public contract.
External identity and idempotency survive response loss, concurrent replay, API restart, and payload conflict with one effect.
Review leases and competing human decisions produce one terminal outcome without rewriting frozen assessment evidence.
Activation and rollback serialize, preserve historical assessments, and switch future scoring at one observable commit boundary.
Worker and outbox recovery preserve fenced effects, stable event identity and body, terminal Work, and an immutable tenant audit chain.
Manager remediation freezes its affected set, appends at most one correction per assessment, preserves history, and survives cancel and worker races.
All three sustained scenarios meet throughput, latency, recovery, and post-load scoring, uniqueness, and audit invariants.
The project owns meaningful unit, real integration, production Chromium, multi-process concurrency, SIGKILL recovery, aggregate, and performance commands.
Tenant data, private signals, credentials, hidden paths, and provider payloads never cross scope or leak.
Codex explains rule ownership, scoring, review, rollback, atomic boundaries, and findings clearly.
Every stage and final handoff reports actual commands, results, risks, and checks not run accurately.
